name: Test of Strength
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.

There are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim.

To test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.
narrative.objectives: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Test of Strength is done. You have shown strength and bravery, and you are now prepared for the final test before these rites are completed.
narrative.requestItemsText: Rok'Alim is also called the Pounder by the centaur tribes in Thousand Needles because of the thundering his fists make as he pummels the creatures brave, or stupid, enough to stand in his path.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 26 to 36, 17,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Test of Faith
quests.objectiveText: If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Endurance
quests.objectiveText: Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Strength
quests.objectiveText: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Final Passage
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
